lines.x: Côte d’Ivoire is evaluating proposals to increase mining royalties from 6% to 9.5% and raise the local development levy to 3% from 0.5%.
The African Development Bank disclosed that 14 African nations face high risk of debt distress while eight are already in distress, highlighting borrowing pressures.
The ECOWAS Federation of Chambers of Mines urged member states to build a regional cyanide manufacturing plant to reduce reliance on imported mining chemicals for gold extraction.
Sofibanque's net profit rose 33% in 2025 to $39.2 million, according to its chief executive Henry Wazne.
